lines.note: Ge'ez 1 includes the title and opening of Greek 2; Greek 2 continues across Ge'ez 2-3, followed by Greek 3 in Ge'ez 3.
Greek 8 is split between Ge'ez 7's helper clause and Ge'ez 8's shelter-of-wings clause; these accompany Greek 7 and 9 respectively.
Combines the vain pursuit and depths of the earth with delivery to the sword and portions for foxes.
